name: Assembled
description:
Connect Claude to Assembled, the workforce management platform for modern support teams. 

Inspect schedules, forecasts, and real-time performance across queues, agents, and sites. Diagnose SLA misses, run what-if scenarios, and analyze trends without exporting a single report. 

Take action directly from chat: adjust forecasts ahead of peak events, publish overtime when you're trending hot, or open VTO when you're overstaffed. 

Combine Assembled data with your HRIS, BI tools, or Slack to answer cross-system questions no single tool can. 

Built for WFM teams and support leaders who need answers in seconds, not hours.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Assembled to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Assembled to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data.mcp.assembledhq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Assembled MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Assembled provides these MCP tools: create_forecast_adjustments, create_overtime_and_voluntary_time_off, get_agent_time_summaries, get_current_time, get_forecast_adjustments, get_forecasted_vs_actual, get_metrics_catalog_and_query_usage, get_overtime_and_voluntary_time_off, get_schedule, get_workforce_config, and query_metrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Assembled?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Assembled in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, DevRev, and Front.
Assembled requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Assembled is developed by Assembled. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
